dogecoin.text:
Metaverse is to Real World what Dogecoin is to Bitcoin. A fantastic cosmic joke. Two spaces apart, yet galaxies away in substance.

Remember, just because you can mint a million-dollar NFT of a pixelated baguette, doesn't mean you should. We're in the Matrix, not a French bakery.

Musk is playing musical chairs with $DOGE and $TSLA, while $ETH reclaims its throne. The new SEC sheriff is laying 'digital asset' bricks. Meanwhile, Bitcoin shorts got a Brazilian wax at $280M. And $BTC? Sipping champagne at $93K. Just another day in the crypto wild west.
